# Batoul Apps prayer-time fixtures

These eight official-timetable fixtures are copied from the adhan-js `main`
branch:

https://github.com/batoulapps/adhan-js/tree/main/Shared/Times

They are used only for offline validation. The adhan-js repository is
distributed under the MIT License; its license text is vendored at
`tests/vendor/LICENSE-adhan-js`.
